title: Sign in and reach the CRM workspace
description: This verifies a merchant can sign in with workspace credentials and land in the authenticated CRM area.

steps.description: Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Verify authenticated workspace navigation is available

title: Connect a Shopify store and save the settings
description: This verifies a merchant can enter Shopify credentials, enable Shopify in auto-reply, and save a successful connection.

steps.description: Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Fill in the shop domain field with a valid store domain
Fill in the Admin API token field with a valid token
Optionally fill in the WhatsApp catalog ID field
Verify the Shopify connection is shown as enabled

title: Sign in and open Shopify settings
description: This verifies a merchant can sign in and reach the Shopify settings area from the authenticated workspace.

steps.description: Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Verify the Shopify settings section is displayed
Verify the Shopify setup state is visible

title: Get Shopify-aware help from the agents playground
description: This verifies a merchant can ask the AI agent a product or order question and receive a Shopify-aware response in the playground.

steps.description: Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Send a test message about a product or order
Verify an AI response is displayed
Verify the response reflects Shopify-aware information

title: Sync the Shopify catalog after connection
description: This verifies a merchant can start a catalog sync after connecting Shopify and see the sync complete in settings.

steps.description: Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Verify catalog sync progress is displayed

title: View an existing Shopify connection
description: This verifies a merchant can return to settings and see the saved Shopify configuration details.

steps.description: Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Verify Shopify store details are displayed
Verify the saved Shopify configuration is visible

title: Disconnect Shopify from settings
description: This verifies a merchant can remove an existing Shopify connection and return to the disconnected state.

steps.description: Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Verify the Shopify connection is no longer active
Verify the disconnected state message is visible

title: Keep the dashboard and workspace navigation available after sign in
description: This verifies a signed-in user can move between core CRM sections without losing authenticated access.

steps.description: Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Verify the settings page is displayed
Verify authenticated workspace navigation remains available

title: Block saving an invalid Shopify token
description: This verifies the app prevents saving a Shopify connection when the Admin API token is missing or invalid and shows a validation error.

steps.description: Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Fill in the shop domain field with a valid store domain
Leave the Admin API token field empty
Verify a token validation error is visible
Verify the Shopify connection is not saved
